preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call the mint function

exploit_hint: Call the mint(address account, uint256 amount) function with the attacker's address as the account parameter and a large amount value. Since there is no cap on the minting amount, the owner can mint unlimited tokens to their address, increasing their token balance without restriction. This can be exploited to inflate supply and dump tokens on the market for profit.
